description: List an item's questions. The structured questions asked on a queue item, with their answers — newest first (max 100). handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

anyOf.description: Where a question stands — `open` (waiting on a person), `completed` (answered), or `cancelled` (withdrawn by the asker).

status.description: Filter by question status, or `all` (the default).

name: ops_questions_list
